params.message:
No critic pass, one-paragraph semiotic read, apply the reviewed plain edit

The Llama critic asked for a rewrite on nearly every new trend (2,314 times, mostly
over the headline): a second write call per trend, and a weaker model judging a
stronger one. critiqueInsight, improveInsight and the insight-critic phase go; the
quality snapshot records the verified claims instead of critic scores. The writer
returns the semiotic read as one paragraph, the one the site shows; writeInsight
stores a string as it is instead of quoting it. plain-edit --apply --from-dry writes
the reviewed dry run, re-checked, and skips a trend that changed since.
